## Pre-Match Scouting Summary — Kiwoom DRX (KRX)

**Role Composition**

Standard five-role spread: one controller (MaKo), two duelists (HYUNMIN, free1ng), one initiator (BeYN), one sentinel (yong). Both yong and free1ng carry flex designations.

**Firepower Distribution**

HYUNMIN is the clear top fragger at 221 ACS / 1.03 rating, operating almost exclusively on Jett (52%) and Raze (32%), with Phoenix as a tertiary option. The notable number here is MaKo: at 195 ACS and a **1.07 rating**, the controller is the team's highest-rated player and ranks second in ACS — he is outperforming both labeled duelists on rating. That is worth flagging when thinking about threat prioritization.

free1ng, despite the duelist designation, rates below 0.90 (192 ACS, 0.88 rating) and has the most fragmented agent pool on the roster — eight agents across the data window, with Neon as the only plurality at 48%. The remaining split across Killjoy, Sova, Tejo, Raze, Sage, Waylay, and Vyse reflects genuine flex usage rather than a settled role.

yong similarly spreads across six agents with no dominant pick — Chamber leads at just 26%, followed by Viper, Cypher, Harbor, and Vyse. His 0.93 rating is below the team average.

BeYN covers the full initiator toolkit (Sova, Fade, Skye, Kayo, Breach) with no single agent above 28%, suggesting he adapts his pick rather than anchoring to one.

**Key Takeaway**

HYUNMIN is the primary carry to account for. MaKo punching above his role in both ACS and rating is the non-obvious firepower note — do not treat him as a passive smoker. free1ng's wide agent spread makes his comp contribution harder to predict game-to-game.
